scope.purpose: Define humanmade gold set catalog, schema, pass criteria, rubric cases, and negative cases before auditing current P33 aggregate and writer artifacts.

deep_gold_case.intended_use: Audit the current agent artifact against a human analyst target.

rubric_gold_case.intended_use: Prevent overfitting to one deep case and define vertical-quality expectations.

negative_gold_case.intended_use: Block common over-promotion, missing-evidence, parser-boundary, and commercial-boundary failures.

cases.user_question: Does AI infrastructure demand translate into high-quality revenue and profit for accelerator, server OEM, foundry/packaging, HBM, and semicap companies?
must_answer_items: Whether AI server demand improves DELL quality of earnings or only adds low-margin pass-through revenue.
How NVDA/AMD/TPU product capability and supply affect server OEM and semicap read-through.
Which customer deployment or official relationship signals support adoption, and what they cannot prove.
How foundry, advanced packaging, HBM, and semicap cycles connect to the AI demand pool.
Whether market expectations and price-in risk change the interpretation of fundamentals.
promotable_boundaries: Hyperscaler capex can support demand pool and read-through direction.
Official product specs and architecture can support product capability and competitive context.
Official customer deployment or partner evidence can support adoption existence and mechanism.
Company-reported segment revenue, margin, backlog, capex, and cash flow can support financial bridge.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer SKU revenue, shipment, ASP, share, or exact supplier allocation without exact rows.
Do not infer DELL AI server gross margin improvement without margin mix or bridge evidence.
Do not treat relationship graph as order, revenue, or margin fact.
Do not use source coverage rows as main thesis claims.
pass_criteria: Memo has a clear thesis before caveats.
Memo connects product, deployment, supply chain, financial quality, market expectation, and counter-thesis.
Each required item is answered or typed as a bounded gap with root-cause category.
Cannot-infer boundaries are stated without turning the memo into a non-answer.
fail_criteria: Output says product layer cannot be judged only because SKU revenue is missing.
Output treats hyperscaler capex as direct supplier order allocation.
Output says financial data is missing when accepted upstream payload contains relevant facts.
Output is primarily a list of evidence rather than a judgment path.
cases.next_use: First audit target for accepted aggregate r7 and Memo Writer payload after user review.

cases.user_question: Does leading-edge and AI-related capex translate into semicap bookings, backlog, shipment, service revenue, and margin quality?
promotable_boundaries: Bookings/backlog/customer concentration can support cycle-quality judgment.
Peer group can scope comparison but cannot be main proof.
forbidden_inferences: Do not equate same peer group with order cycle proof.
Do not infer China exposure exact value without disclosed row.
pass_criteria: Separates tool-cycle proof from broad semicap scope.
Explains why bookings/backlog and customer mix matter to quality of revenue.
fail_criteria: Uses only ASML/AMAT/LRCX/KLAC same-sector relationship as the core evidence.
cases.next_use: Regression rubric after AI/Semis deep case.

cases.user_question: Is AI capex turning into cloud/SaaS monetization, retention, RPO/ARR, and margin, or only increasing cost?
promotable_boundaries: Company RPO/ARR/cloud growth can support monetization.
Developer ecosystem can support adoption context but not revenue exact.
forbidden_inferences: Do not equate AI product launch with monetized revenue.
Do not treat capex growth alone as positive without margin/depreciation bridge.
pass_criteria: Explains monetization versus capex burden.
Separates product adoption evidence from revenue exact evidence.
fail_criteria: Only says AI spend is high without discussing economic return.

cases.user_question: How do rates and credit cycle affect NIM, deposit cost, loan growth, losses, capital and shareholder return?
promotable_boundaries: Balance-sheet rows can support financial quality.
Macro rate series can support context and sensitivity, not issuer-specific NIM by itself.
forbidden_inferences: Do not analyze banks only by revenue or EPS.
Do not infer credit loss improvement from stock price movement.
pass_criteria: Includes three-statement and balance-sheet-led analysis.
Connects rates to deposits, NIM, credit, and capital.
fail_criteria: Ignores deposits, capital ratios, and credit quality.

cases.user_question: Do clinical, regulatory, procedure, reimbursement and product adoption signals support product performance?
promotable_boundaries: Regulatory approval can support product existence and eligibility.
Procedure/adoption proxy can support directional context but not market share exact.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer sales share from trial existence.
Do not convert FDA context into revenue exact.
pass_criteria: Separates R&D/regulatory context from commercial performance.
Identifies whether product adoption evidence is exact, proxy, or gap.
fail_criteria: Uses clinical/FDA context as direct sales proof.

cases.user_question: How do data-center and electrification demand translate into load growth, regulated assets, capex, power pricing, debt and cash flow?
promotable_boundaries: Company capex/debt/cash-flow rows can support quality judgment.
Data-center demand proxy can support load direction but not exact contract economics.
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat AI power demand as automatic earnings growth.
Do not ignore financing and regulatory constraints.
pass_criteria: Links demand to regulated return, capex and balance sheet.
Distinguishes merchant power exposure from regulated utility exposure.
fail_criteria: Only says data centers use more power.

cases.user_question: Is growth driven by traffic, ticket, price/mix, unit volume, store expansion, promotion, or margin improvement?
promotable_boundaries: Company traffic/ticket/SSS rows can support operating analysis.
Macro and channel proxy can support context but not POS exact.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer sell-through exact from generic consumer proxy.
Do not treat price increases as unit demand without traffic/volume evidence.
pass_criteria: Breaks growth into traffic, ticket, price/mix, units and margin.
Separates disclosed operating KPI from commercial POS gap.

cases.user_question: How do deliveries, ASP, inventory, recalls, capacity, financing and industrial cycle affect profit quality?
promotable_boundaries: Disclosed deliveries and inventory can support operating quality.
Recall data can support product quality/risk context.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer margin quality from delivery volume alone.
Do not infer ASP exact from channel commentary without disclosed row.
pass_criteria: Connects volume, price, inventory and margin.
Separates product/quality risk from revenue growth.
fail_criteria: Only uses deliveries or order headlines.

cases.user_question: Are fundamentals and product changes already priced in by valuation, positioning, liquidity, credit and event risk?
promotable_boundaries: Market signals can support price-in and risk-appetite context.
Corporate actions can support capital feedback analysis.
forbidden_inferences: Do not turn market positioning into investment advice.
Do not treat options or holder proxy as fundamental improvement.
pass_criteria: Separates long-term value judgment from market price-in and positioning.
States capital feedback boundaries.
fail_criteria: Treats price action or options flow as proof of company fundamentals.

cases.user_question: How should the agent behave when SKU revenue is missing but product/spec/deployment evidence exists?
promotable_boundaries: Specs, architecture, benchmark and deployment can support bounded product capability judgment.
forbidden_inferences: SKU revenue
shipment
ASP
market share exact
pass_criteria: Product layer remains analyzable even without SKU revenue.
Exact KPI absence is explained separately.
fail_criteria: Says product layer cannot be judged because SKU revenue is missing.
cases.next_use: Immediate negative check before P33 memo audit.

cases.user_question: How should hyperscaler capex evidence be used without over-infering supplier allocation?
promotable_boundaries: Hyperscaler capex can support demand pool and directional read-through.
forbidden_inferences: specific supplier order value
supplier market share
OEM gross margin improvement
pass_criteria: Demand-pool conclusion is separated from supplier allocation.
fail_criteria: Capex is written as direct evidence of supplier orders or share gains.
cases.next_use: Immediate negative check before P33 memo audit.

cases.user_question: How should relationship edges be used without promoting them to financial facts?
promotable_boundaries: Graph edges can support mechanism, scope, and search guidance.
forbidden_inferences: order amount
revenue
gross margin
backlog
pass_criteria: Every graph edge has an investment role and a cannot-infer boundary.
fail_criteria: Relationship graph is used as main financial proof.

cases.user_question: How should the agent classify located public filings whose tables or numbers are not parsed?
promotable_boundaries: Located public source can prove source availability and parser obligation.
forbidden_inferences: public_source_absent
issuer_does_not_disclose
pass_criteria: Gap is attributed to parser/locator/local disclosure adapter when source exists.
fail_criteria: Memo says public source is absent after the file was located.

cases.vertical: Evidence projection and memo writer consumption
cases.user_question: How should the system behave when upstream evidence exists but the memo says it is missing?
promotable_boundaries: Available upstream exact evidence must be consumed or explicitly rejected with reason.
forbidden_inferences: data_missing
public_source_absent
pass_criteria: System fails the case and attributes the defect to selector/projection/writer, not source absence.
fail_criteria: Final memo says evidence is missing while upstream payload contains it.
cases.next_use: Immediate audit check over accepted aggregate r7 and writer payload.

cases.user_question: How should public proxy be separated from commercial tracker exact data?
promotable_boundaries: Public proxy can support direction or context only.
forbidden_inferences: market share exact
sell-through exact
app revenue exact
real-time gamma
borrow cost exact
pass_criteria: Public proxy is labeled as bounded context and exact gap is exposed.
fail_criteria: Public proxy is used as commercial tracker exact.
cases.next_use: Boundary regression across future vertical expansion.
